@[rust_loop_body]
def verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body
  (limbs : Array Std.U32 4#usize) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize)
  (row : Array Std.U64 4#usize) (basis : field.M31) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) × (Array Std.U64
    4#usize) × field.M31) (Array Std.U64 4#usize))

  (basis : field.M31) (limbs : Array Std.U32 4#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 4#usize)

def verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64) ×
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64))
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64))
  := do
  let (o, iter1, next_back) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (fun im => let im1 := next_back im none
                                back im1))
  | some limb =>
    let i ← lift (limb &&& 2147483647#u64)
    let i1 ← limb >>> 31#i32
    let limb1 ← i + i1
    ok (cont (iter1, fun im => let im1 := next_back im (some limb1)
                               back im1))

/-- [port23push_native::verifier::update_residue_row]: loop 1:
    Source: 'src/update.rs', lines 14:8-14:64 -/
@[rust_loop]
def verifier.update_residue_row_loop1
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  :
  Result (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, back1) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body iter1 back1)
    (iter, back)

/-- [port23push_native::verifier::update_residue_row]:
    Source: 'src/update.rs', lines 6:0-16:1 -/
def verifier.update_residue_row (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
  (row : Array Std.U64 4#usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31)
  (flush : Bool) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 4#usize)
  := do
  let i := power.c0.a
  let i1 := power.c0.b
  let i2 := power.c1.a
  let i3 := power.c1.b
  let row1 ←
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize }
      row basis (Array.make 4#usize [ i, i1, i2, i3 ])
  if flush
  then
    let (iter, into_iter_back) ←
      arrayIntoIter row1
    let back ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 iter (fun im => im)
    ok (into_iter_back back)
  else ok row1

/-- [port23push_native::verifier::{port23push_native::verifier::BatchedWeights}::push]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 10:4-13:5 -/
def verifier.BatchedWeights.push (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
  (self : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Std.Usize) (power : field.QM31)
  (basis : field.M31) :
  Result verifier.BatchedWeights
  := do
  let i ← lift (self.terms &&& 3#usize)
  let (a, index_mut_back) ←
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array
      Std.U64 4#usize)) self.«raw» index
  let a1 ← verifier.update_residue_row arrayIntoIter a power basis (i = 3#usize)
  let v := index_mut_back a1
  ok { self with «raw» := v }

/-- [port23push_native::verifier::Port23PUSH_push]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 16:4-18:5
    Visibility: public -/
def verifier.Port23PUSH_push (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
  (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Std.Usize) (power : field.QM31)
  (basis : field.M31) :
  Result verifier.BatchedWeights
  := do
  verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis

namespace Port25ARRAY
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Iter (T : Type) := core.slice.iter.IterMut T

/-- Literal array -> mutable slice -> iter_mut delegation, with the caller's
transformer continuation applied to the original iterator before readback.
No backend registration or native association is installed. -/
def arrayIntoIter {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) :
    Result (Iter T × ((Iter T → Iter T) → Array T N)) := do
  let (s, arrayBack) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut a)
  let (it, sliceBack) ← core.slice.Slice.iter_mut s
  ok (it, fun transform => arrayBack (sliceBack (transform it)))

theorem delegation {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) :
    arrayIntoIter a = ok (⟨a.to_slice,0⟩,
      fun transform => Array.from_slice a (transform ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice) := by
  rfl

/-- Full back law includes the existing wrapper's fallback for malformed
transformers. Actual next/back closures preserve the slice length. -/
theorem back_carrier {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N)
    (f : Iter T → Iter T) :
    (Array.from_slice a (f ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice).val =
      if (f ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice.val.length = N.val
      then (f ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice.val else a.val := by
  simp only [Array.from_slice]
  split <;> rfl

theorem back_identity {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) :
    Array.from_slice a ((id : Iter T → Iter T) ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice = a := by
  cases a
  simp [Array.from_slice, Array.to_slice]

/-- Concrete transformer ABI for the exact Port23 row carrier. -/
def concrete : Port23PUSH.ArrayIntoIter := arrayIntoIter

#print axioms arrayIntoIter
#print axioms delegation
#print axioms back_carrier
#print axioms back_identity
#print axioms concrete
end Port25ARRAY
end

import Port25ARRAY_Std
import S7Kani2OwnedPush
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port25ARRAY
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer

def addWord (raw : U64) (limb basis : U32) : Result U64 := do
  let a ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb)
  let b ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis)
  let p ← a * b
  raw + p

def foldWord (x : U64) : Result U64 := do
  let low ← lift (x &&& 2147483647#u64)
  let high ← x >>> 31#i32
  low + high

theorem fold_total (x : U64) : ∃ y, foldWord x = ok y := by
  obtain ⟨y,hy,_⟩ := foldExecution_success x
  refine ⟨y,?_⟩
  change foldExecution x = ok y
  exact hy

def folded (x : U64) : U64 := Classical.choose (fold_total x)
theorem fold_eq (x : U64) : foldWord x = ok (folded x) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (fold_total x)
def finish (flush : Bool) (x : U64) : U64 := if flush then folded x else x

theorem scalar_all_results (raw : U64) (limb basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
    S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned raw limb basis flush =
      (do let x ← addWord raw limb basis; ok (finish flush x)) := by
  simp only [S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned, addWord, bind_assoc_eq,
    lift, bind_tc_ok]
  congr 1
  funext p
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases flush <;> simp only [finish, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
  exact fold_eq x

/-- Multiplication is total on all full U32 words. Raw addition remains checked. -/
theorem product_total (limb basis : U32) :
    ∃ p, ((core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb) *
      (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis) : Result U64) = ok p := by
  have ha := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value limb
  have hb := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value basis
  have hp : (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb).val *
      (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [ha,hb]
    have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt limb.bv.isLt basis.bv.isLt
    exact h
  obtain ⟨p,hp,_⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducerOps.mul_success _ _ hp
  exact ⟨p,hp⟩

/-- A total pure fold can pass a checked computation without losing its fail
or div outcome. The computation's original order is preserved. -/
theorem total_fold_order {A B C : Type} (m : Result A) (n : Result B)
    (f : A → C) :
    (do let a ← m; let b ← n; ok (f a,b)) =
      (do let a ← m; let c ← ok (f a); let b ← n; ok (c,b)) := by
  cases m <;> rfl

#print axioms addWord
#print axioms foldWord
#print axioms fold_total
#print axioms folded
#print axioms fold_eq
#print axioms finish
#print axioms scalar_all_results
#print axioms product_total
#print axioms total_fold_order
end Port25ARRAY
end

import Port25ARRAY_Lane
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port26ROW
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open Port23PUSH Port25ARRAY
abbrev Row := Array U64 4#usize
abbrev Power := Port23PUSH.field.QM31

def toK (q : Power) : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.K :=
  ⟨(q.c0.a,q.c0.b),(q.c1.a,q.c1.b)⟩

theorem row_four (row : Row) : ∃ a b c d, row = Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d] := by
  rcases row with ⟨l,h⟩
  change l.length = 4 at h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨a,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨b,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨c,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨d,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨e,l⟩
  · exact ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩
  · simp at h

/-- One symbolic source loop unfolding, retaining checked operations and order. -/
theorem add_unroll (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (row : Row)
    (basis : U32) (limbs : Array U32 4#usize) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 iter row basis limbs =
      (do let step ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body limbs iter row basis
          match step with
          | done out => ok out
          | cont (it,r,b) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 it r b limbs) := by
  unfold verifier.update_residue_row_loop0
  rw [loop.eq_def]
  simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  cases h : verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body limbs iter row basis with
  | ok step => cases step with
    | done out => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
    | cont state => rcases state with ⟨it,r,b⟩; simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]

theorem range_next (j k : Usize) (active : j.val < 4) (inc : k.val = j.val+1) :
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize ⟨j,4#usize⟩ =
      ok (some j,⟨k,4#usize⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,it⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x; rfl) (by intro a b; rfl)
      ⟨j,4#usize⟩ active)
  subst o
  have hk : it.start = k := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by dsimp at hs; omega)
  rcases it with ⟨start,ending⟩
  dsimp at hk he
  subst start
  subst ending
  exact run

/-- Exact existing owned row on arbitrary full words. This establishes its
all-adds-then-pure-fold normal form, without claiming the mutable loop join. -/
theorem owned_four (a b c d : U64) (power : Power) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
    S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) (toK power) basis flush =
      (do let x0 ← addWord a power.c0.a basis
          let x1 ← addWord b power.c0.b basis
          let x2 ← addWord c power.c1.a basis
          let x3 ← addWord d power.c1.b basis
          ok (Array.make 4#usize [finish flush x0,finish flush x1,
            finish flush x2,finish flush x3])) := by
  change (do
    let x0 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned a power.c0.a basis flush
    let x1 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned b power.c0.b basis flush
    let x2 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned c power.c1.a basis flush
    let x3 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned d power.c1.b basis flush
    ok (Array.make 4#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3])) = _
  simp only [scalar_all_results,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

/-- ACTUAL emitted fold body, including end-of-iteration deferred back closure.
Fold totality removes its possible failure; next's Result is retained exactly. -/
theorem fold_body_complete (it : Iter U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body it back =
      (do let (o,it1,nextBack) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next it
          match o with
          | none => ok (done (fun im => back (nextBack im none)))
          | some limb => ok (cont (it1,
              fun im => back (nextBack im (some (folded limb)))))) := by
  cases h : core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next it with
  | ok value =>
    rcases value with ⟨o,it1,nextBack⟩
    cases o with
    | none =>
      simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_ok]
      rfl
    | some limb =>
      simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_ok]
      change (do let y ← foldWord limb
                 ok (cont (it1,fun im => back (nextBack im (some y))))) = _
      rw [fold_eq,bind_tc_ok]
      rfl
  | fail e => simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_div]


#print axioms toK
#print axioms row_four
#print axioms add_unroll
#print axioms range_next
#print axioms owned_four
#print axioms fold_body_complete
end Port26ROW
end

    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize ⟨4#usize,4#usize⟩ =
      ok (none,⟨4#usize,4#usize⟩) := by

theorem add_body0 (a b c d : U64) (p q r s basis : U32) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body (Array.make 4#usize [p,q,r,s]) ⟨0#usize,4#usize⟩

    range_next 1#usize 2#usize (by decide) (by decide)]

      (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis =

          ok (cont (⟨3#usize,4#usize⟩,Array.make 4#usize [a,b,y,d],basis))) := by
  rw [verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body,

  simp only [addWord,bind_assoc_eq]

theorem add_body3 (a b c d : U64) (p q r s basis : U32) :

      (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis =

    range_next 3#usize 4#usize (by decide) (by decide)]

theorem add_tail4 (row : Row) (basis : U32) (limbs : Array U32 4#usize) :

  rw [add_unroll]
  simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body,range_end,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

theorem add_tail3 (a b c d : U64) (p q r s basis : U32) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 ⟨3#usize,4#usize⟩ (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis
      (Array.make 4#usize [p,q,r,s]) =
      (do
        let x3 ← addWord d s basis
        ok (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,x3])) := by
  rw [add_unroll,add_body3]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 ⟨2#usize,4#usize⟩ (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis
      (Array.make 4#usize [p,q,r,s]) =

theorem add_tail1 (a b c d : U64) (p q r s basis : U32) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 ⟨1#usize,4#usize⟩ (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis
      (Array.make 4#usize [p,q,r,s]) =
      (do
        let x1 ← addWord b q basis
        let x2 ← addWord c r basis
        let x3 ← addWord d s basis
        ok (Array.make 4#usize [a,x1,x2,x3])) := by
  rw [add_unroll,add_body1]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

        let x2 ← addWord c r basis
        let x3 ← addWord d s basis

  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

import Port26ROW_Steps
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port26ROW
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open Port23PUSH Port25ARRAY

def atRow (a b c d : U64) (n : Nat) : Iter U64 :=
  ⟨(Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]).to_slice,n⟩
def put (n : Nat) (y : U64) (im : Iter U64) : Iter U64 :=
  {im with slice := im.slice.setAtNat n y}

theorem fold_unroll (it : Iter U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it back =
      (do let step ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body it back
          match step with
          | done out => ok out
          | cont (it,b) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it b) := by
  unfold verifier.update_residue_row_loop1
  rw [loop.eq_def]
  cases h : verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body it back with
  | ok step => cases step with
    | done out => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
    | cont state => rcases state with ⟨it,b⟩; simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]

theorem fold_body0 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 0) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 1, fun im => back (put 0 (folded a) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body1 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 1) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 2, fun im => back (put 1 (folded b) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body2 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 2) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 3, fun im => back (put 2 (folded c) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body3 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 3) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 4, fun im => back (put 3 (folded d) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body4 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 4) back =
      ok (done back) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_tail4 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 4) back =
      ok (fun im => back (im)) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]

theorem fold_tail3 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 3) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 3 (folded d) (im))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail4 a b c d _

theorem fold_tail2 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 2) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 2 (folded c) (put 3 (folded d) (im)))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail3 a b c d _

theorem fold_tail1 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 1) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 1 (folded b) (put 2 (folded c) (put 3 (folded d) (im))))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail2 a b c d _

theorem fold_tail0 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 0) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 0 (folded a) (put 1 (folded b) (put 2 (folded c) (put 3 (folded d) (im)))))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body0]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail1 a b c d _

/-- Actual iterator continuation is applied to its original input, then the
existing from_slice readback. All four writes and the entire carrier retained. -/
theorem fold_readback (a b c d : U64) :
    (do let (it,back) ← concrete (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
        let f ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it id
        ok (back f)) =
      ok (Array.make 4#usize [folded a,folded b,folded c,folded d]) := by
  change (do let f ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 0) id
             ok (Array.from_slice (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
               (f (atRow a b c d 0)).slice)) = _
  rw [fold_tail0]
  rfl

#print axioms atRow
#print axioms put
#print axioms fold_unroll
#print axioms fold_body0
#print axioms fold_body1
#print axioms fold_body2
#print axioms fold_body3
#print axioms fold_body4
#print axioms fold_tail0
#print axioms fold_tail1
#print axioms fold_tail2
#print axioms fold_tail3
#print axioms fold_tail4
#print axioms fold_readback
end Port26ROW

import Port23PUSH_Source
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port23PUSH
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Full-result outer normalization of the *mutable source-emitted* push.
The row update is unchanged, with its external mutable-array primitive explicit.
No row-success, overflow, canonicality or in-range premise is imposed. -/
theorem push_complete (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31) :
    verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis =
      (do
        let row ← alloc.vec.Vec.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index
        let updated ← verifier.update_residue_row arrayIntoIter row power basis
          ((b.terms &&& 3#usize) = 3#usize)
        ok {b with raw := b.raw.set index updated}) := by
  by_cases bound : index.val < b.raw.val.length
  · obtain ⟨row,hr,hrow⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    obtain ⟨⟨old,back⟩,hm,hold,hback⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    have hm' : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index =
        ok (old,back) := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index]
      exact hm
    have hr' : alloc.vec.Vec.index
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index =
        ok row := hr
    have oldrow : old = row := by
      simpa only [hold] using hrow.symm
    simp only [verifier.BatchedWeights.push, lift, bind_tc_ok, hm', hr', hback, oldrow]
    rfl
  · simp [verifier.BatchedWeights.push, alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize, bound,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index, core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice, Slice.index_usize, lift]

/-- An invalid index rejects before entering either row loop. -/
theorem push_bad_index (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31)
    (bad : ¬ index.val < b.raw.val.length) :
    verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis = fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds := by
  rw [push_complete]
  simp [alloc.vec.Vec.index, core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice,
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize, Slice.index_usize, bad]

private theorem bind_ok {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (k : A → Result B) (out : B)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok out) : ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok out := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => cases h
  | div => cases h

/-- Entire successful Vec frame, not only equality of the selected row.
No bound or arithmetic domain is assumed. Failure/div behavior is in push_complete. -/
theorem push_success_frame (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
    (b after : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31)
    (run : verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis = ok after) :
    ∃ row updated,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize))
        b.raw index = ok row ∧
      verifier.update_residue_row arrayIntoIter row power basis
        ((b.terms &&& 3#usize) = 3#usize) = ok updated ∧
      after = {b with raw := b.raw.set index updated} := by
  rw [push_complete] at run
  obtain ⟨row,hr,run⟩ := bind_ok _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨updated,hu,run⟩ := bind_ok _ _ _ run
  exact ⟨row,updated,hr,hu,(Result.ok.inj run).symm⟩

#print axioms push_complete
#print axioms push_bad_index
#print axioms bind_ok
#print axioms push_success_frame
end Port23PUSH
end

import Port26ROW_Add
import Port26ROW_Fold
import Port23PUSH_Frame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port26ROW
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open Port23PUSH Port25ARRAY

/-- Complete mutable source row with the content delegation instance, on every
full four-word carrier. Checked add failures and div are preserved; total folds
commute across checked later lanes because they introduce no failure/effect in
this pure Result interpretation. Native association/effects are separate. -/
theorem row_complete (row : Row) (power : Power) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
    verifier.update_residue_row concrete row power basis flush =
      S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row (toK power) basis flush := by
  rcases row_four row with ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩
  rw [owned_four]
  change (do
    let row1 ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 ⟨0#usize,4#usize⟩
      (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis
      (Array.make 4#usize [power.c0.a,power.c0.b,power.c1.a,power.c1.b])
    if flush then
      (do let (it,back) ← concrete row1
          let f ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it id
          ok (back f))
    else ok row1) = _
  rw [add_tail0]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  congr 1
  funext x0
  congr 1
  funext x1
  congr 1
  funext x2
  congr 1
  funext x3
  cases flush with
  | false => rfl
  | true => exact fold_readback x0 x1 x2 x3

/-- Exact carrier conversion: all raw rows, terms and four power words. -/
def toBW (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights :=
  ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩
def fromBW (b : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights) : verifier.BatchedWeights :=
  ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩

theorem carrier_roundtrip (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) : fromBW (toBW b) = b := by
  cases b
  rfl

/-- Unconditional owned outer normalization. No safe domain or successful row
execution is assumed. Indexing before mutation preserves invalid-index failure. -/
theorem owned_push_complete (b : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights)
    (index : Usize) (power : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.K) (basis : U32) :
    S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned b index power basis =
      (do let row ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
            b.raw index
          let updated ← S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row power basis
            ((b.terms &&& 3#usize) = 3#usize)
          ok {b with raw := b.raw.set index updated}) := by
  by_cases bound : index.val < b.raw.val.length
  · obtain ⟨row,hr,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    obtain ⟨⟨old,back⟩,hm,_,hback⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    have hr' : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
        b.raw index = ok row := hr
    have hm' : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
        b.raw index = ok (old,back) := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index]
      exact hm
    simp only [S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned,hr',lift,bind_tc_ok,hm',hback]
    all_goals rfl
  · simp [S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned,alloc.vec.Vec.index,
      core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice,alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize,
      Slice.index_usize,bound]

/-- Actual mutable source-emitted push equals the owned source push under exact
carrier conversion, including full Results and the entire Vec.set/terms frame.
The explicit collection delegation is derived; native association is separate. -/
theorem push_complete (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize)
    (power : Power) (basis : U32) :
    verifier.BatchedWeights.push concrete b index power basis =
      (do let out ← S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned (toBW b) index (toK power) basis
          ok (fromBW out)) := by
  rw [Port23PUSH.push_complete,owned_push_complete]
  simp only [row_complete,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok,toBW,fromBW]
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms row_complete
#print axioms toBW
#print axioms fromBW
#print axioms carrier_roundtrip
#print axioms owned_push_complete
#print axioms push_complete
end Port26ROW
end

import ExtractedSourceDigestAddresses

/-! Exact input/output pairs of reached source digest calls. Kept independent
of commitment-cut recovery so source/literal coupling need not load that proof
closure merely to describe the actual calls. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceDigestLog
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1
open FS2.Duplex AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge
/-- Three actual digest input/output pairs retained by a source call. -/
def callLog {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) : List (Bytes × State) :=
  [(flatten (TranscriptStep.absorbParts c.before.state c.tag c.record.framed), decodeState c.absorbed),
   (flatten (TranscriptStep.readParts c.absorbed 1#u8), decodeState c.block),
   (flatten (TranscriptStep.readParts c.absorbed 2#u8), decodeState c.state)]

def sourceLog {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) : List (Bytes × State) := cs.flatMap callLog

theorem callLog_actual {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) (q : Bytes × State) (hq : q ∈ callLog c) :
    ∃ input : Slice (Slice U8), ∃ output : TranscriptStep.Bytes32,
      q = (flatten input,decodeState output) ∧ D.digest c.before.hash input = .ok output := by
  simp only [callLog,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hq
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨_,_,rfl,c.absorb⟩
  · exact ⟨_,_,rfl,c.read1⟩
  · exact ⟨_,_,rfl,c.read2⟩

theorem sourceLog_length {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) : (sourceLog cs).length = 3 * cs.length := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih => simp [sourceLog,callLog,List.flatMap_cons] at ih ⊢; omega

theorem sourceLog_absorb_mem {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) (hc : c ∈ cs) :
    (flatten (TranscriptStep.absorbParts c.before.state c.tag c.record.framed),
      decodeState c.absorbed) ∈ sourceLog cs := by
  exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨c,hc,by simp [callLog]⟩


#print axioms callLog_actual
#print axioms sourceLog_length
#print axioms sourceLog_absorb_mem
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceDigestLog
end

import ExtractedSourceSemanticSampler
import ExtractedSourceDigestOracle
import R1UnifiedPayloadStep
import R1UnifiedPayloadValue
import R1LiteralTranscript
import R1SelectedTranscriptParams

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceLiteralSamplerStep

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceDigestAddresses
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.SelectedTranscriptParams
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple

private abbrev sourceChallenge {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) : AspisWideTower.WideExact :=
  algebraMap QM31Exact AspisWideTower.WideExact
    (ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent (SamplerTransport.toOld c.q)))

/-- A reached source call simulates the literal payload sampler when their
prior state and framed payload agree. The source digest equations are obtained
from the actual trace's functional-oracle theorem, not postulated per call. -/
theorem call_simulates_literal_payload
    {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    {before after : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)}
    (run : SourceFull25.Trace D pre before after cs)
    (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) (hc : c ∈ cs)
    (pubInput : Slice U8) (root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32) (length : U32)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State)
    (horacle : ∀ a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L,
      SourceDigestOracle.oracle D before.hash pubInput root length a = Hbytes a.toBytes)
    (hD : ∀ d ∈ cs, (rawBytes d.record.framed).length ≤ SelectedTranscriptParams.D)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < 25) (hi0 : i ≠ 0)
    (hrow : c.row.val = i)
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (mm : SelectedTranscriptParams.Message)
    (hm : LiteralTranscript.erase m = TranscriptView.Message.payload mm)
    (hstate : UnifiedSampler.stateOf SelectedTranscriptParams.params
      (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) = decodeState c.before.state)
    (hbytes : SelectedTranscriptParams.params.enc mm = rawBytes c.record.framed) :
    Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
        (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
          (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m).toProgram).2.1 ∧
      decodeState c.after.state =
        (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
          (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m).toProgram).2.2 := by
  have hbound : (rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤ SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D :=
    hD c hc
  have htag : SelectedTranscriptParams.params.lbl i = decodeByte c.tag := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change (SelectedTranscriptParams.label i).val = decodeByte c.tag
    rw [SelectedTranscriptParams.label_val i (by omega)]
    calc
      160 + i = 160 + c.row.val := by rw [hrow]
      _ = c.tag.val := by
        rw [← c.record_row]
        exact c.tag_code.symm
      _ = decodeByte c.tag := rfl
  have habsorb : absorbA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
      (decodeState c.before.state) (decodeByte c.tag)
      (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound =
      UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
        (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm := by
    unfold UnifiedSampler.absorb
    rw [hstate, htag]
    congr 1
    exact hbytes.symm
  have htrace := SourceDigestOracle.trace_functional SelectedTranscriptParams.params
    run pubInput root length hD c hc
  have habsVal : decodeState c.absorbed =
      Hbytes (absorbA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (decodeState c.before.state) (decodeByte c.tag)
        (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound).toBytes := by
    calc
      decodeState c.absorbed = SourceDigestOracle.oracle D before.hash pubInput root length
          (absorbA SelectedTranscriptParams.params (decodeState c.before.state)
            (decodeByte c.tag) (rawBytes c.record.framed) (hD c hc)) := htrace.1
      _ = Hbytes (absorbA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (decodeState c.before.state) (decodeByte c.tag)
          (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound).toBytes := by
        rw [horacle]
  have hblock : decodeState c.block =
      Hbytes (squeezeA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (Hbytes (UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
          (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm).toBytes)).toBytes := by
    calc
      decodeState c.block = SourceDigestOracle.oracle D before.hash pubInput root length
          (squeezeA SelectedTranscriptParams.params (decodeState c.absorbed)) := htrace.2.1
      _ = Hbytes (squeezeA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (decodeState c.absorbed)).toBytes := horacle _
      _ = _ := by rw [habsVal, habsorb]
  have hnext : decodeState c.after.state =
      Hbytes (advanceA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (Hbytes (UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
          (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm).toBytes)).toBytes := by
    calc
      decodeState c.after.state = SourceDigestOracle.oracle D before.hash pubInput root length
          (advanceA SelectedTranscriptParams.params (decodeState c.absorbed)) := htrace.2.2
      _ = Hbytes (advanceA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (decodeState c.absorbed)).toBytes := horacle _
      _ = _ := by rw [habsVal, habsorb]
  have hq := AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceSemanticSampler.call_semChal c
  have hsampler := AspisR1.UnifiedPayloadValue.sampler_payload_value
    SelectedTranscriptParams.params (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params,
      SelectedTranscriptParams.D]) (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
      i hi0 (by omega) (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm
  have hstep := AspisR1.UnifiedPayloadStep.payload_step
    SelectedTranscriptParams.params (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params,

      i hi0 (by omega) (by omega) (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm

import RawSourceLiteralSamplerStep
import ExtractedSourceFull25Frames
import R1LiteralTranscript
import R1SelectedTranscriptParams

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceLiteralTraceLift

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.SelectedTranscriptParams
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge
open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisR1.UnifiedPayloadValue

def sourceChallenge {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) : AspisWideTower.WideExact :=
  algebraMap QM31Exact AspisWideTower.WideExact
    (ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent (SamplerTransport.toOld c.q)))

def sourcePrefix {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} : (i : Nat) → (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) →
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) →
    (bound : ∀ c ∈ cs, (SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤
      SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D) → LiteralTranscript.Prefix
  | _, P, [], _ => P
  | i, P, c :: cs, bound =>
      sourcePrefix (i + 1) (P.ext
        (.payload ⟨SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed, bound c (by simp)⟩)
        (.ordinary (sourceChallenge c), decodeState c.after.state)) cs
        (fun d hd => bound d (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hd))
def literalPrefix {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (Hbytes : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Bytes → State) :
    (i : Nat) → (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) →
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) →
    (bound : ∀ c ∈ cs, (SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤
      SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D) → LiteralTranscript.Prefix
  | _, P, [], _ => P
  | i, P, c :: cs, bound =>
      let mm : SelectedTranscriptParams.Message :=
        ⟨SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed, bound c (by simp)⟩
      literalPrefix Hbytes (i + 1) (P.ext (.payload mm)
        (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval
          (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
          (LiteralTranscript.samp i P (.payload mm)).toProgram).2) cs
        (fun d hd => bound d (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hd))

/-- The positive-row source trace and literal sampler build the same extended
prefix. The first row is deliberately excluded: it uses the dedicated public
initializer and is handled by a separate row-zero bridge. -/
theorem positive_trace_simulation
    {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    {before after : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)}
    (run : SourceFull25.Trace D pre before after cs)
    (hash : Hash) (hbeforeHash : before.hash = hash)
    (pubInput : Slice U8) (root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32) (length : U32)
    (Hbytes : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Bytes → State)
    (horacle : ∀ a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L,
      SourceDigestOracle.oracle D before.hash pubInput root length a = Hbytes a.toBytes)
    (bound : ∀ c ∈ cs,
      (SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤
        SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D)
    (i : Nat) (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix)
    (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hcount : i + cs.length ≤ 25)
    (hrow : before.next_row.val = i)
    (hstate : UnifiedSampler.stateOf SelectedTranscriptParams.params
      (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) = decodeState before.state) :
    literalPrefix Hbytes i P cs bound = sourcePrefix i P cs bound ∧
      UnifiedSampler.stateOf SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix (sourcePrefix i P cs bound)) =
          decodeState after.state := by
  revert bound i P hi0 hcount hrow hstate hbeforeHash
  induction run with
  | nil self =>
      intro hbeforeHash bound i P hi0 hcount hrow hstate
      exact ⟨rfl, by simpa only [sourcePrefix] using hstate⟩
  | @cons tailAfter tailCalls c tail ih =>
      intro hbeforeHash bound i P hi0 hcount hrow hstate
      have hlenPos : 0 < (c :: tailCalls).length := by simp
      have hlt : i < 25 := by
        have hh : i + (c :: tailCalls).length ≤ 25 := hcount
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hlenPos) hh
      have hrowc : c.row.val = i := by
        calc
          c.row.val = c.record.row.val := congrArg (fun x => x.val) c.record_row.symm
          _ = c.before.next_row.val := congrArg (fun x => x.val) c.before_row
          _ = i := hrow
      have hnext : c.after.next_row.val = i + 1 := by
        have hn : c.after.next_row = c.next := by rw [c.carried]
        calc
          c.after.next_row.val = c.next.val := congrArg (fun x => x.val) hn
          _ = c.record.row.val + 1 := c.next_row
          _ = c.row.val + 1 := congrArg (fun x => x.val + 1) c.record_row
          _ = i + 1 := by rw [hrowc]
      have hbound :
          (SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤
            SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D := bound c (by simp)
      let mm : SelectedTranscriptParams.Message :=
        ⟨SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes c.record.framed, hbound⟩
      have hstep := SourceLiteralSamplerStep.call_simulates_literal_payload
        (SourceFull25.Trace.cons c tail) c (by simp) pubInput root length Hbytes
        (by simpa only [hbeforeHash] using horacle)
        bound i hlt hi0 hrowc P (.payload mm) mm rfl hstate rfl
      change Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
          (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval
            (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
            (LiteralTranscript.samp i P (.payload mm)).toProgram).2.1 ∧
        decodeState c.after.state =
          (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval
            (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
            (LiteralTranscript.samp i P (.payload mm)).toProgram).2.2 at hstep
      have hpair :
          (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval
            (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
            (LiteralTranscript.samp i P (.payload mm)).toProgram).2 =
            (Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c), decodeState c.after.state) :=
        Prod.ext hstep.1.symm hstep.2.symm
      let Pnext := P.ext (.payload mm)
        ((AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval
          (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
          (LiteralTranscript.samp i P (.payload mm)).toProgram).2)
      have hstateNext : UnifiedSampler.stateOf SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix Pnext) = decodeState c.after.state := by
        dsimp [Pnext]
        rw [LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix_ext, UnifiedSampler.stateOf_ext]
        exact hstep.2.symm
      have hcountTail : (i + 1) + tailCalls.length ≤ 25 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hcount
        omega
      have hboundTail : ∀ d ∈ tailCalls,
          (SourceDigestAddresses.rawBytes d.record.framed).length ≤
            SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D := by
        intro d hd
        exact bound d (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hd)
      have hhashNext : c.after.hash = c.before.hash := by
        rw [c.carried]
      have horacleNext : ∀ a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L,
          SourceDigestOracle.oracle D c.after.hash pubInput root length a = Hbytes a.toBytes := by
        intro a
        rw [hhashNext]
        exact horacle a
      have hafterHash : c.after.hash = hash := hhashNext.trans hbeforeHash
      have htail := ih horacleNext hafterHash hboundTail (i + 1) Pnext (by omega)
        hcountTail hnext hstateNext
      have hprefixNext : Pnext = P.ext (.payload mm)
          (Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c), decodeState c.after.state) := by
        dsimp [Pnext]
        rw [hpair]
      constructor
      · change literalPrefix Hbytes (i + 1) Pnext tailCalls hboundTail =
          sourcePrefix (i + 1)
            (P.ext (.payload mm)
              (Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c), decodeState c.after.state))
            tailCalls hboundTail
        rw [← hprefixNext]
        exact htail.1
      · simp only [sourcePrefix]
        rw [← hprefixNext]
        exact htail.2

end AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceLiteralTraceLift
end

import RawSourceDigestLog
import RawSourceLiteralTraceLift

/-! Couple reached source calls to one global byte oracle. No equality of the
constructed source oracle on unqueried addresses is required. The actual global
log embedding and consistency remain explicit. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceGlobalOracleCoupling
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1 AspisR1.TranscriptView
open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceDigestAddresses
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceDigestLog
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript AspisR1.SelectedTranscriptParams
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple

abbrev sourceChallenge := @SourceLiteralTraceLift.sourceChallenge

/-- Actual retained source outputs, interpreted at their three reached byte
addresses by containment in the same consistent global log. -/
theorem call_functional_from_log
    {Hash M Cv : Type} {L : Nat} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (params : Params M Cv L) (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre))
    (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) (hc : c ∈ cs)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) (tr : List (Bytes × State))
    (hsource : sourceLog cs ⊆ tr) (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = Hbytes q.1)
    (hbound : (rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤ params.D) :
    decodeState c.absorbed = Hbytes (absorbA params (decodeState c.before.state)
      (decodeByte c.tag) (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound).toBytes ∧
    decodeState c.block = Hbytes (squeezeA params (decodeState c.absorbed)).toBytes ∧
    decodeState c.after.state = Hbytes (advanceA params (decodeState c.absorbed)).toBytes := by
  have ha := hcons _ (hsource (sourceLog_absorb_mem cs c hc))
  have h1 := hcons (flatten (TranscriptStep.readParts c.absorbed 1#u8),decodeState c.block)
    (hsource (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨c,hc,by simp [callLog]⟩))
  have h2 := hcons (flatten (TranscriptStep.readParts c.absorbed 2#u8),decodeState c.state)
    (hsource (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨c,hc,by simp [callLog]⟩))
  change decodeState c.absorbed = Hbytes (flatten _) at ha
  rw [absorb_address params _ _ _ hbound] at ha
  change decodeState c.block = Hbytes (flatten _) at h1
  rw [squeeze_address params] at h1
  change decodeState c.state = Hbytes (flatten _) at h2
  rw [advance_address params] at h2
  refine ⟨ha,h1,?_⟩
  rw [c.carried]
  exact h2

/-- A reached positive source row equals the literal payload sampler under the
same globally logged oracle, using no all-address source-oracle premise. -/
theorem call_simulates_literal_payload
    {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre))
    (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) (hc : c ∈ cs)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) (tr : List (Bytes × State))
    (hsource : sourceLog cs ⊆ tr) (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = Hbytes q.1)
    (hD : ∀ d ∈ cs, (rawBytes d.record.framed).length ≤ SelectedTranscriptParams.D)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < 25) (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hrow : c.row.val = i)
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (mm : SelectedTranscriptParams.Message)
    (hm : LiteralTranscript.erase m = TranscriptView.Message.payload mm)
    (hstate : UnifiedSampler.stateOf SelectedTranscriptParams.params
      (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) = decodeState c.before.state)
    (hbytes : SelectedTranscriptParams.params.enc mm = rawBytes c.record.framed) :
    Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
      (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
        (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m).toProgram).2.1 ∧
    decodeState c.after.state =
      (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
        (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m).toProgram).2.2 := by
  have hbound : (rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤ SelectedTranscriptParams.params.D :=
    hD c hc
  have htag : SelectedTranscriptParams.params.lbl i = decodeByte c.tag := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change (SelectedTranscriptParams.label i).val = decodeByte c.tag
    rw [SelectedTranscriptParams.label_val i (by omega)]
    calc
      160 + i = 160 + c.row.val := by rw [hrow]
      _ = c.tag.val := by
        rw [← c.record_row]
        exact c.tag_code.symm
      _ = decodeByte c.tag := rfl
  have habsorb : absorbA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
      (decodeState c.before.state) (decodeByte c.tag)
      (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound =
      UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
        (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm := by
    unfold UnifiedSampler.absorb
    rw [hstate, htag]
    congr 1
    exact hbytes.symm
  have htrace := call_functional_from_log SelectedTranscriptParams.params cs c hc
    Hbytes tr hsource hcons hbound
  have habsVal : decodeState c.absorbed =
      Hbytes (absorbA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (decodeState c.before.state) (decodeByte c.tag)
        (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound).toBytes := htrace.1
  have hblock : decodeState c.block =
      Hbytes (squeezeA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (Hbytes (UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
          (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm).toBytes)).toBytes := by
    rw [← habsorb, ← habsVal]
    exact htrace.2.1
  have hnext : decodeState c.after.state =
      Hbytes (advanceA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
        (Hbytes (UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
          (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm).toBytes)).toBytes := by
    rw [← habsorb, ← habsVal]
    exact htrace.2.2
  have hq := AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceSemanticSampler.call_semChal c
  have hsampler := AspisR1.UnifiedPayloadValue.sampler_payload_value
    SelectedTranscriptParams.params (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params,
      SelectedTranscriptParams.D]) (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
      i hi0 (by omega) (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm
  have hstep := AspisR1.UnifiedPayloadStep.payload_step
    SelectedTranscriptParams.params (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params,
      SelectedTranscriptParams.D]) (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
      i hi0 (by omega) (by omega) (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm
  have hchallenge :
      Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
        Value.ordinary (SelectedTranscriptParams.params.σ i
          (Hbytes (squeezeA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
            (Hbytes (UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
              (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm).toBytes)).toBytes)) := by
    congr 1
    calc
      sourceChallenge c = R0P.SemSource.semChal (decodeState c.block) := hq
      _ = SelectedTranscriptParams.params.σ i
          (Hbytes (squeezeA SelectedTranscriptParams.params
            (Hbytes (UnifiedSampler.absorb SelectedTranscriptParams.params i
              (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) mm).toBytes)).toBytes) := by
        symm
        rw [SelectedTranscriptParams.params_sigma, SelectedChallengeMap.semantic_row i hi]
        rw [hblock]
  constructor
  · rw [LiteralTranscript.samp, hm]
    change Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
      (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
        (UnifiedSampler.samp SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params, SelectedTranscriptParams.D])
          i (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) (.payload mm)).toProgram).2.1
    rw [hsampler]
    exact hchallenge
  · rw [LiteralTranscript.samp, hm]
    change decodeState c.after.state =
      (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
        (UnifiedSampler.samp SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params, SelectedTranscriptParams.D])
          i (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) (.payload mm)).toProgram).2.2
    rw [hstep]
    exact hnext

#print axioms call_functional_from_log
#print axioms call_simulates_literal_payload
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceGlobalOracleCoupling
end

import RawSourceGlobalOracleCoupling
import R1LiteralByteSampler

/-! The actual public initializer and row zero under the same globally logged
byte oracle, without constructing a separate all-address source oracle. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceGlobalOracleInitial
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1 AspisR1.TranscriptView
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript AspisR1.SelectedTranscriptParams
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceDigestAddresses
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex
open SourceDigestLog
private abbrev params := SelectedTranscriptParams.params
abbrev sourceChallenge := @SourceLiteralTraceLift.sourceChallenge

/-- The exact successful public serializer/constructor digest call. -/
structure PublicInitCall {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash)
    (pubInput : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32) (before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash) where
  encoded : alloc.vec.Vec U8
  length : U32
  state : TranscriptStep.Bytes32
  serialized : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes pubInput =
    ok (.Ok encoded)
  converted : core.convert.num.ptr_try_from_impls.TryFromU32Usize.try_from
    (Slice.len (alloc.vec.Vec.deref encoded)) = ok (.Ok length)
  digest : D.digest before.hash (TranscriptStep.initParts (alloc.vec.Vec.deref encoded) root length) =
    ok state
  carried : before = { state, hash := before.hash, next_row := 0#u8 }

theorem public_success_has_init_call
    {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash)
    (pubInput : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32) (before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash)
    (hpublic : r1_semantic.public_transcript D pubInput before.hash root = ok (.Ok before)) :
    Nonempty (PublicInitCall D pubInput root before) := by
  obtain ⟨encoded,hencoded,hnew⟩ := public_new D before.hash pubInput root before hpublic
  obtain ⟨length,state,hlen,hdigest,hcarried⟩ :=
    TranscriptStep.new_success D before.hash (alloc.vec.Vec.deref encoded) root before hnew
  exact ⟨⟨encoded,length,state,hencoded,hlen,hdigest,hcarried⟩⟩

def initPair {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pubInput : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    (c : PublicInitCall D pubInput root before) : Bytes × State :=
  (flatten (TranscriptStep.initParts (alloc.vec.Vec.deref c.encoded) root c.length),decodeState c.state)

/-- The actual initialized state is the global oracle value at the literal
statement's public-initializer address. Log membership and the two public/root
representation equalities are the remaining source interfaces. -/
theorem initializer_state_from_log
    {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pubInput : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    (c : PublicInitCall D pubInput root before)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) (tr : List (Bytes × State))
    (hinitLog : initPair c ∈ tr) (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = Hbytes q.1)
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (c1 : State)
    (hpublicBytes : P.statement.pubBytes = rawBytes (alloc.vec.Vec.deref c.encoded))
    (hroot : c1 = decodeState root) :
    decodeState before.state = Hbytes
      (PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1).toBytes := by
  have hL : 75 + (rawBytes (alloc.vec.Vec.deref c.encoded)).length ≤ SelectedTranscriptParams.L := by
    rw [← hpublicBytes]
    exact P.statement.initFits
  have haddr := init_address (alloc.vec.Vec.deref c.encoded) root c.length
    (successful_length _ _ c.converted) hL
  have hsame : PublicInitFrame.addr (rawBytes (alloc.vec.Vec.deref c.encoded)) hL
      (decodeState root) = PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1 := by
    unfold PublicInitFrame.addr FS2.Duplex.Addr.ofBytes
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [PublicInitFrame.frame,TrailingStateFrame.frame,PublicInitFrame.pre,hpublicBytes,hroot]
  have hvalue := hcons _ hinitLog
  change decodeState c.state = Hbytes (flatten _) at hvalue
  rw [haddr,hsame] at hvalue
  have hstate : before.state = c.state := congrArg (fun t => t.state) c.carried
  rw [hstate]
  exact hvalue

/-- Reached row-zero source success agrees with the literal initializer under
one globally logged oracle; no equality on unqueried addresses is supplied. -/
theorem call_simulates_literal_initial
    {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash} {pre : r1_wire.Prefix}
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) (c : SourceFull25.Call D pre) (hc : c ∈ cs)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) (tr : List (Bytes × State))
    (hsource : sourceLog cs ⊆ tr) (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = Hbytes q.1)
    (hD : ∀ d ∈ cs, (rawBytes d.record.framed).length ≤ params.D)
    (hrow : c.row.val = 0)
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (c1 : State) (word : LiteralTranscript.C1Word)
    (hinit : decodeState c.before.state = Hbytes
      (PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1).toBytes)
    (hempty : rawBytes c.record.framed = PublicInitFrame.emptyRecord) :
    Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
      (eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
        (LiteralTranscript.samp 0 P (.initial c1 word)).toProgram).2.1 ∧
    decodeState c.after.state =
      (eval (fun a : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L => Hbytes a.toBytes)
        (LiteralTranscript.samp 0 P (.initial c1 word)).toProgram).2.2 := by
  let H : Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L → State := fun a => Hbytes a.toBytes
  have hbound : (rawBytes c.record.framed).length ≤ params.D := hD c hc
  have htagcode : c.tag.val = 160 := by
    have ht := c.tag_code
    rw [c.record_row, hrow] at ht
    simpa using ht
  have htag : decodeByte c.tag = 160 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact htagcode
  have h5 : 5 ≤ params.D := by
    norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params, SelectedTranscriptParams.D, params]
  let initAddr := PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1
  let initState := H initAddr
  let rowAddr := PublicInitFrame.row0 params h5 initState
  let rowState := H rowAddr
  change decodeState c.before.state = initState at hinit
  have habsorb : absorbA params (decodeState c.before.state) (decodeByte c.tag)
      (rawBytes c.record.framed) hbound = rowAddr := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [rowAddr, PublicInitFrame.row0, absorbA, initState, hinit, htag, hempty]
  have htrace := SourceGlobalOracleCoupling.call_functional_from_log params cs c hc
    Hbytes tr hsource hcons hbound
  have habsVal : decodeState c.absorbed = rowState := by
    change decodeState c.absorbed = Hbytes rowAddr.toBytes
    rw [← habsorb]
    exact htrace.1
  have hblock : decodeState c.block = H (squeezeA params rowState) := by
    change decodeState c.block = Hbytes (squeezeA params rowState).toBytes
    rw [← habsVal]
    exact htrace.2.1
  have hnext : decodeState c.after.state = H (advanceA params rowState) := by
    change decodeState c.after.state = Hbytes (advanceA params rowState).toBytes
    rw [← habsVal]
    exact htrace.2.2
  have hq := AspisR1PublicPreparation.SourceSemanticSampler.call_semChal c
  have hchallenge : sourceChallenge c = params.σ 0 (H (squeezeA params rowState)) := by
    calc
      sourceChallenge c = R0P.SemSource.semChal (decodeState c.block) := hq
      _ = params.σ 0 (H (squeezeA params rowState)) := by
        rw [SelectedTranscriptParams.params_sigma,
          SelectedChallengeMap.semantic_row 0 (by omega)]
        rw [hblock]
  have hliteral :
      eval H (LiteralTranscript.samp 0 P (.initial c1 word)).toProgram =
        ([(initAddr, H initAddr), (rowAddr, rowState),
          (squeezeA params rowState, H (squeezeA params rowState)),
          (advanceA params rowState, H (advanceA params rowState))],
          TranscriptView.liftChallenge
            (params.σ 0 (H (squeezeA params rowState)), H (advanceA params rowState))) := by
    change eval H
      (UnifiedSampler.samp params h5 0 (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P) (.initial c1)).toProgram = _
    rw [UnifiedSampler.row_zero]
    rw [AspisR1.DuplexSamplers.initial_eval]
    rfl
  rw [hliteral]
  constructor
  · change Value.ordinary (sourceChallenge c) =
      Value.ordinary (params.σ 0 (H (squeezeA params rowState)))
    exact congrArg Value.ordinary hchallenge
  · change decodeState c.after.state = H (advanceA params rowState)
    exact hnext

#print axioms initializer_state_from_log
#print axioms call_simulates_literal_initial

import RawSourceGlobalOracleInitial

/-! Conditional tx1 log assembly. Inventory coverage is deliberately a named
obligation: no whole-tx1 execution trace is emitted by the retained extraction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1DigestLog
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1
open FS2.Duplex AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames
open SourceDigestAddresses SourceDigestLog SourceGlobalOracleInitial

/-- A pair has a successful call witness in the actual extracted Digest32 API. -/
def ActualPair {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash) (q : Bytes × State) : Prop :=
  ∃ (hash : Hash) (input : Slice (Slice U8)) (output : TranscriptStep.Bytes32),
    q = (flatten input, decodeState output) ∧ D.digest hash input = ok output

/-- Named ROM/backend premise, including independence of part segmentation and
of the retained backend value. This is not a theorem about arbitrary Digest32. -/
def ByteOracleBackend {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, ActualPair D q → q.2 = Hbytes q.1

/-- Rows 25–32 and the non-sampler calls (commitment authentication and the
three checkpoint hashes included) must be supplied separately. Repeated calls
are retained; this is not a first-read count or an ordered execution trace. -/
def log {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (init : PublicInitCall D pub root before)
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre))
    (samplerRows25To32 otherTx1Calls : List (Bytes × State)) : List (Bytes × State) :=
  initPair init :: (sourceLog cs ++ samplerRows25To32 ++ otherTx1Calls)

/-- Coverage must be derived from an execution extraction; source call witnesses
alone cannot establish that all reached calls have been listed. -/
def Tx1InventoryComplete (reached : Bytes × State → Prop)
    (tr : List (Bytes × State)) : Prop := ∀ q, reached q → q ∈ tr

def SamplerRows25To32Logged (rows : List (Bytes × State))
    (reachedSamplerSuffix : Bytes × State → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, reachedSamplerSuffix q → q ∈ rows

/-- Deferred tx2 execution embedding, at the same byte-oracle carrier. -/
def Tx2EmbeddingObligation (reachedTx2 : Bytes × State → Prop)
    (tr2 : List (Bytes × State)) : Prop := ∀ q, reachedTx2 q → q ∈ tr2

/-- Deferred cross-transaction obligation. Separate per-transaction oracles
are insufficient: both logs must agree with this SAME Hbytes. -/
def CrossTransactionConsistency (Hbytes : Bytes → State)
    (tr1 tr2 : List (Bytes × State)) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ tr1 ++ tr2, q.2 = Hbytes q.1

theorem prefix_contained {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (init : PublicInitCall D pub root before)
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) (suffix rest : List (Bytes × State)) :
    initPair init :: sourceLog cs ⊆ log init cs suffix rest := by
  intro q hq
  simp only [List.mem_cons] at hq
  rcases hq with rfl | hq
  · exact List.mem_cons_self
  · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ hq))

theorem log_actual {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (init : PublicInitCall D pub root before)
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) (suffix rest : List (Bytes × State))
    (hsuffix : ∀ q ∈ suffix, ActualPair D q)
    (hrest : ∀ q ∈ rest, ActualPair D q) :
    ∀ q ∈ log init cs suffix rest, ActualPair D q := by
  intro q hq
  simp only [log, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append] at hq
  rcases hq with rfl | ((hq | hq) | hq)
  · exact ⟨before.hash, _, init.state, rfl, init.digest⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcall⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hq
    obtain ⟨input, output, heq, hd⟩ := callLog_actual c q hcall
    exact ⟨c.before.hash, input, output, heq, hd⟩
  · exact hsuffix q hq
  · exact hrest q hq

theorem log_consistent {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (init : PublicInitCall D pub root before)
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) (suffix rest : List (Bytes × State))
    (hsuffix : ∀ q ∈ suffix, ActualPair D q)
    (hrest : ∀ q ∈ rest, ActualPair D q)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) (hbackend : ByteOracleBackend D Hbytes) :
    ∀ q ∈ log init cs suffix rest, q.2 = Hbytes q.1 := by
  intro q hq
  exact hbackend q (log_actual init cs suffix rest hsuffix hrest q hq)

theorem every_reached_call {Hash : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 Hash}
    {pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public}
    {root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32} {before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript Hash}
    {pre : r1_wire.Prefix} (init : PublicInitCall D pub root before)
    (cs : List (SourceFull25.Call D pre)) (suffix rest : List (Bytes × State))
    (hsuffix : ∀ q ∈ suffix, ActualPair D q)
    (hrest : ∀ q ∈ rest, ActualPair D q)
    (Hbytes : Bytes → State) (hbackend : ByteOracleBackend D Hbytes)
    (reached : Bytes × State → Prop)
    (hinventory : Tx1InventoryComplete reached (log init cs suffix rest)) :
    ∀ q, reached q → q ∈ log init cs suffix rest ∧ q.2 = Hbytes q.1 := by
  intro q hq
  exact ⟨hinventory q hq,
    log_consistent init cs suffix rest hsuffix hrest Hbytes hbackend q (hinventory q hq)⟩

/-- A local pairwise coherence fact follows; it does not prove log ordering,
first-read budgets, memoized sampling laws or the missing inventory. -/
theorem same_address_same_output (Hbytes : Bytes → State)
    (tr : List (Bytes × State)) (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = Hbytes q.1)
    (q r : Bytes × State) (hq : q ∈ tr) (hr : r ∈ tr) (ha : q.1 = r.1) :
    q.2 = r.2 := by rw [hcons q hq, hcons r hr, ha]

#print axioms prefix_contained
#print axioms log_actual
#print axioms log_consistent
#print axioms every_reached_call
#print axioms same_address_same_output
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1DigestLog
end

import CurrentPreparedScratchReachability
import ExtractedDigest32Callers
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.PAln_OpeningCalls
open r1_wire TranscriptStep
private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) : ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
private theorem pair_bind_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok pair => cases pair with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
theorem absorb_success {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (self after : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (h : transcript.Transcript.absorb D self row payload = ok after) :
    ∃ tag state, 160#u8 + row = ok tag ∧
      D.digest self.hash (CallerStep.openingAbsorbParts self.state tag
        (UScalar.cast .U32 (Slice.len payload)) payload) = ok state ∧
      after = {self with state} := by
  simp only [transcript.Transcript.absorb,lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨tag,htag,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨state,hstate,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  exact ⟨tag,state,htag,hstate,(Result.ok.inj h).symm⟩

theorem absorb_hash {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (self after : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (h : transcript.Transcript.absorb D self row payload = ok after) :
    after.hash = self.hash := by
  obtain ⟨tag,state,_,_,rfl⟩ := absorb_success D self after row payload h
  rfl

theorem scalar_success {H : Type} (B : PreparedModel.Boundaries) (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (self after : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (nonzero : Bool) (out : aspis_core.field.WideExact)
    (h : PreparedModel.scalar B D self row payload nonzero = ok (out,after)) :
    ∃ block, transcript.Transcript.block D self row payload = ok (block,after) ∧
      (if nonzero then B.gamma block else B.ordinary block) = ok out := by
  unfold PreparedModel.scalar at h
  obtain ⟨block,mid,hblock,h⟩ := pair_bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨value,hvalue,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨mark,htrace,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases mark
  have he := Result.ok.inj h
  have hv : value = out := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have ht : mid = after := congrArg Prod.snd he
  exact ⟨block,by simpa only [ht] using hblock,by simpa only [hv] using hvalue⟩

theorem rho_success {H : Type} (B : PreparedModel.Boundaries) (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (self after : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (out : aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (h : PreparedModel.scalar_k B D self row payload = ok (out,after)) :
    ∃ block, transcript.Transcript.block D self row payload = ok (block,after) ∧
      sampler.qm31_sample block = ok out := by
  unfold PreparedModel.scalar_k at h
  obtain ⟨block,mid,hblock,h⟩ := pair_bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨value,hvalue,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨wide,hwide,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨mark,htrace,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases mark
  have he := Result.ok.inj h
  have hv : value = out := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have ht : mid = after := congrArg Prod.snd he
  exact ⟨block,by simpa only [ht] using hblock,by simpa only [hv] using hvalue⟩

#print axioms absorb_success
#print axioms absorb_hash
#print axioms scalar_success
#print axioms rho_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.PAln_OpeningCalls

import PSem_SourceCuts
import CurrentPreparedScratchReachability
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.PAln_Borrowed
open AspisR1CurrentCaller InstalledPreparation BorrowedClaimPrepared

/-- Invert the installed complete source operation. The retained output and
scratch are the ones mapped to the actual returned current carriers. -/
theorem original_success (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31 → Result AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.PE)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (input scratch : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
    (out : verifier.Prepared)
    (success : originalNew sampling embed D sem v hash input=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    ∃ (retained : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared)
      (rs : Array AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact 29#usize),
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
        (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.concreteBoundaries
          (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.InstalledMeaning.installedBoundaries sampling embed))
        (retainedDigest D) (retainedSem sem) (retainedView v) hash
        (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.mapArray retainedE input)=ok (.Ok retained,rs) ∧
      currentPrepared retained=out ∧ AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.mapArray currentE rs=scratch := by
  rw [originalNew_eq_transport] at success
  cases call : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.concreteBoundaries
        (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.InstalledMeaning.installedBoundaries sampling embed))
      (retainedDigest D) (retainedSem sem) (retainedView v) hash
      (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.mapArray retainedE input) with
  | fail e => simp only [call,bind_tc_fail] at success; cases success
  | div => simp only [call,bind_tc_div] at success; cases success
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨ret,rs⟩
    cases ret with
    | Err e => simp only [call,bind_tc_ok] at success; cases success
    | Ok retained =>
      simp only [call,bind_tc_ok] at success
      have eq := Result.ok.inj success
      exact ⟨retained,rs,rfl,core.result.Result.Ok.inj (congrArg Prod.fst eq),
        congrArg Prod.snd eq⟩

theorem original_reached (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31 → Result AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.PE)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (input scratch : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
    (out : verifier.Prepared)
    (success : originalNew sampling embed D sem v hash input=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    ∃ (retained : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared)
      (rs : Array AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact 29#usize),
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.Reachable
        (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.concreteBoundaries
          (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.InstalledMeaning.installedBoundaries sampling embed))
        (retainedDigest D) (retainedSem sem) (retainedView v) hash retained rs ∧
      currentPrepared retained=out ∧ AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.mapArray currentE rs=scratch := by
  obtain ⟨retained,rs,accepted,outEq,scratchEq⟩ :=
    original_success sampling embed D sem v hash input scratch out success
  exact ⟨retained,rs,
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.prepare_success
      _ (retainedDigest D) (retainedSem sem) (retainedView v) hash retained rs
      (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.mapArray retainedE input) accepted,outEq,scratchEq⟩

#print axioms original_reached
#print axioms original_success
end AspisR1.PAln_Borrowed

import R1LiteralMatchingData

/-! Deterministic decomposition of a successful literal matching-data read.
This exposes the component reads already required by the reader; it adds no
acceptance, source-refinement, or security claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.PAln_MatchingFacts

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningStages
open AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead
open AspisR1.OpeningRecordCodec
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningData
open AspisR1.MatchingSupport

abbrev E := AspisR1.LiteralMatchingData.E

/-- The strict opening payloads assembled by `LiteralMatchingData.read` from
its staged rows and the separately read final row. -/
def payloads (staged : LiteralOpeningStages.Second)
    (row31 : OpeningRecordCodec.Payload .final) : SelectedOpeningData.Payloads :=
  { row25 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.toGamma.row25
    row26 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.toGamma.row26
    row27 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.toGamma.row27
    row28 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.row28
    row29 := staged.toFirst.row29
    row30 := staged.row30
    row31 := row31 }

theorem read_success_components
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (h : LiteralMatchingData.read rs = some d) :
    ∃ (common : LiteralOpeningView.View)
      (staged : LiteralOpeningStages.Second)
      (row31 : OpeningRecordCodec.Payload .final)
      (word : LiteralTranscript.VWord)
      (gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 : E),
      LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some common ∧
      LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond rs = some staged ∧
      LiteralOpeningStages.readAt rs 31 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .final) = some row31 ∧
      LiteralTranscript.vAt rs = some word ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 27 = some gamma ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 28 = some kappa ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 29 = some alpha0 ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 30 = some alpha1 ∧
      d = SelectedOpeningData.data (payloads staged row31) common.word word
        common.functionals common.baseFunctional gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 := by
  unfold LiteralMatchingData.read at h
  cases hcommon : LiteralOpeningView.read rs with

import PAln_OpeningReach

/-- All opening suffix calls on the two-fold path. The output equation binds
challenges, queries, rho and final state to the SAME returned preparation. -/
def Double {H : Type} (B : PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries) (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (view : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array aspis_core.field.WideExact 29#usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ (t0 t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 : transcript.Transcript H)
    (inactive root : Array U8 32#usize) (bytes1 bytes2 : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 : aspis_core.field.WideExact)
    (rho : aspis_core.field.QM31) (queries : Array U32 22#usize)
    (claim : aspis_core.field.WideExact),
    transcript.Transcript.new D hash sem.transcript.state view.variant=ok t0 ∧
    PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t0 27#u8 view.y1 true=ok (gamma,t1) ∧
    B.sampling.toBytes view.inactive=ok inactive ∧
    PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t1 28#u8 (Array.to_slice inactive) false=ok (kappa,t2) ∧
    PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t2 29#u8 view.round0 false=ok (alpha0,t3) ∧
    core.option.Option.unwrap view.folded_root=ok root ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8
      (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U8 256#usize) (Array.to_slice root)=ok bytes1 ∧
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 bytes1 view.round1=ok bytes2 ∧
    PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t3 30#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes2) false=ok (alpha1,t4) ∧
    B.sampling.queries D t4 31#u8 view.final_message=ok (.Ok queries,t5) ∧
    PreparedModel.scalar_k B.sampling D t5 32#u8 emptyPayload=ok (rho,t6) ∧
    B.powers 29#usize gamma=ok scratch ∧
    B.claim D sem view.y1 view.inactive scratch kappa=ok (.Ok claim) ∧
    out=output sem view gamma kappa (Array.make 2#usize [alpha0,alpha1]) rho queries claim t6

theorem double_of_reached {H : Type} (B : PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries) (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (view : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array aspis_core.field.WideExact 29#usize)
    (variant : view.variant=.S2)
    (reached : Reachable B D sem view hash out scratch) : Double B D sem view hash out scratch := by
  obtain ⟨t0,t1,t2,t3,inactive,gamma,kappa,alpha0,seed,g,serialized,k,a,tail⟩ := reached
  cases tail with
  | single folds tail =>
    rw [variant] at folds
    simp [transport.Variant.folds,transport.Variant.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqVariant.eq,
      read_discriminant,transport.Variant.read_discriminant] at folds
  | double folds root bytes1 bytes2 alpha1 t4 rootCall first second sampled tail =>
    obtain ⟨queries,t5,t6,rho,claim,query,rhoCall,powers,claimed,same⟩ := tail
    exact ⟨t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,inactive,root,bytes1,bytes2,gamma,kappa,alpha0,alpha1,
      rho,queries,claim,seed,g,serialized,k,a,rootCall,first,second,sampled,query,rhoCall,powers,claimed,same⟩

import ExtractedSemanticRoundsModel
